prompt: You ask Claude to analyze a 50-page policy document and it sometimes states things the document does not say. Which prompt change most directly reduces this?

options.text: Ask Claude to be more confident and decisive.
Ask it to first extract word-for-word quotes relevant to the task, then base its analysis only on those quotes.
Shorten the document by deleting every other paragraph.
Add "do not hallucinate" at the end of the prompt.

explanation: For long-document tasks (above roughly 20k tokens), having Claude extract exact quotes first grounds the answer in the source text and reduces hallucinations. You can also have it find a supporting quote for each claim and retract claims that lack one.
